notes.title: Creepy Tale: Some Other Place
notes.content:
Hi there!

While big studios are competing in the detail of facial animation and the size of the game world, we continue to bend our line and calmly creating small and maximally cozy creepy tales.

The new part returns to the roots, where simplicity and minimalism frighten and fascinate, confuse and provide food for thought. We decided to discard the superfluous and bring to perfection all that remains.
Creepy Tale: Some Other Place tells a completely new story that takes place in our fairytale world. A dynamic quest awaits you, packed with vivid events and characters.

A quiet autumn morning promised a wonderful fishing. Young Martin, having dug up a many of worms, wound a new fishing line on his older brother's fishrod, and with a brisk step came to his favorite place to the old broken bridge. As time went. The bucket gradually filled with fish and Martin was already thinking about going home, when suddenly someone patted him on the shoulder...

Events swirled and now our hero is already rushing after a strange furry monster who stole all his catch. Having made his way through the hollow of a huge tree and looking around, Martin realized that everything around had changed. Taking a deep breath, the boy felt that the air was filled with new, unfamiliar aromas. He took a closer look and realized that he would not recognize this forest, he would not recognize this world. Perhaps such a thought would not have crossed the mind of an adult, but the child understood right away that he was in “some other place”.

Friends! Add game to wishlist!

notes.title: Creepy Tale 3: Ingrid Penance released
notes.content:
Hello!

Creepy Tale 3: Ingrid Penance is out on Steam. We invite you to explore into our creepy, but still fabulous world and help Ingrid atone for her sins. Or contrariwise - become a pure evil. You choose. True, during the first passage it will not be easy to keep one vector of actions and not create evil or good that you did not plan. The game has both a specific choice and a hidden one. Good deeds will be especially difficult. There is also a neutral ending. There are three endings in total. And how else, because this is the third part.

For lovers of stats: the game has hundreds of animations, tens of thousands of various sprites, more than 811 sounds and 42 music tracks. The total number of voice files is 666 for each language, which I think is a good sign.

Despite the fact that we have more than 10 years of game development behind us, we are now - in serial terminology - only at the end of the third season ... And then the most interesting awaits us.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/1761780/Creepy_Tale_3_Ingrid_Penance/

notes.title: Creepy Tale 2 is now available on Switch!
notes.content:
Now you can get terrified without leaving your bed!
We have released a port of Creepy Tale 2 on Nintendo Switch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39891438/a7677b8c44837707293ef2f3acd93c21b87c978b.png[/img]

Hello, my friends!

We have a very special announcement for you today! In preparation for the following spooky season Creepy Brothers Studio, in cooperation with our publisher - No Gravity Games -  have decided to give you guys a little treat. 

Starting now, you’ll be able to grab Creepy Tale 2 on Nintendo eShop, and play it on the go, with the help of a Switch! It’s been a long time coming and our dream from the start, to let people experience our game on as many platforms as possible, and it’s finally coming true. 

Of course, every creator dreams of reaching as many people as possible with their creation but we are especially excited about this one. Portability is a huge quality of life improvement and enables people who otherwise wouldn’t have bothered with our game, for various reasons, to give it a go. It is one thing to sit down in a chair to play a game, it’s another to casually play for 30 minutes in your bed. Although we must warn you, perhaps playing Creepy Tale 2 before sleeping is not advised, and that is for 2 reasons. First one, you won’t be able to stop, because the game will suck you into its world ;) and the second one - if you do somehow manage to stop playing, will you really dare to sleep…? 
How about you watch the release trailer, then come back and let me know how you feel.

[previewyoutube=lksNKF8eOv4;full][/previewyoutube]

Stick around for the news of Creepy Tale 2 reaching even more platforms, and I hope you’re as excited for that prospect as we are! Thank you everyone for playing our games and supporting us in our mission to deliver our spooky inventions to your doorstep.



Anyway, have a very nice day, and we’ll see you in the next update!

notes.title: Creepy Tale 2 released!
notes.content:
Hi there!

I very happy to show our new game - Creepy Tale 2!

Free your little sister from the influence of a natural evil force in this horror puzzle adventure!

KEY FEATURES
[list]
[*] Solve ingenious puzzles that will lead Lars to his sister and the creature behind her kidnap.
[*] Enjoy a narrative-focused, accessible gameplay suitable for any kind of player.
[*] Explore a kingdom widely inspired by the legends of Central European oral tradition, where magic creatures try to coexist peacefully with mankind — and, sometimes, even protect them from evil forces.
[*] Feel the gloomy essence of this creepy tale through its decadent cartoonish art style
[/list]

notes.title: Creepy Tale 2 releases on July 16
notes.content:
Dark fairy tale adventure Creepy Tale 2 releases on July 16

Free your little sister from the influence of a natural evil force in this horror puzzle adventure, sequel to the acclaimed Creepy Tale!

This creepy adventure takes place in an unnamed kingdom where humans and supernatural beings coexist peacefully -- until an unknown evil force starts bewitching young girls to use them as servants. This mystery will touch the lives of young Lars’ family, our protagonist: after his father was attacked by this entity, he will be forced to dive into the unknown to unveil the truth behind all this dark magic to save his own little sister, Ellie. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39891438/6f9581a20ee6c9757d9d60ffd968ae0b1ea28d6b.png[/img]
